name: cobol-exec-cics-operand-scope
body: cics reads only the PROGRAM operand of LINK and XCTL and the SERVICE or WEBSERVICE operand of INVOKE; a PROGRAM(identifier) is a func-value call target and not also a data reference, and every other CICS operand (COMMAREA, INTO, FROM and the like) yields no reference, since SPEC is silent on them. Limit: data items passed to CICS draw no uses edge. Upgrade when SPEC or an IBM source decides CICS operand references.
